We are looking for a dynamic and results-driven Talent Acquisition Specialist with experience in hiring US IT Recruiters and staffing professionals. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of the US IT Staffing industry, recruitment processes, and hiring requirements for W2, C2C, and 1099 recruitment professionals.

The primary responsibility will be to identify, attract, interview, and hire experienced US IT Recruiters, Bench Sales Recruiters, Recruitment Leads, and other staffing professionals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. US IT Recruiter Hiring**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment of US IT Recruiters and staffing professionals.
* Source and hire candidates with hands-on experience in W2, C2C, and 1099 recruitment.
* Identify recruiters experienced in working with US direct clients, implementation partners, and prime vendors.
* Hire professionals with experience using US job portals such as Dice, Monster, CareerBuilder, and LinkedIn.
* Evaluate candidates based on their US staffing knowledge, communication skills, recruitment performance, and placement experience.

**2. Talent Sourcing & Acquisition**

* Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, employee referrals, and other recruitment platforms.
* Develop a strong pipeline of experienced US IT recruitment professionals.
* Conduct initial screening, telephonic interviews, and HR assessments.
* Coordinate technical and managerial interview rounds.
* Manage salary negotiations, offer releases, and joining formalities.

**3. US IT Staffing Knowledge**

* Understand the US IT Staffing recruitment lifecycle.
* Have knowledge of W2, C2C, 1099, and full-time hiring models.
* Understand recruitment requirements for US-based clients and vendors.
* Evaluate recruiters' experience with applicant tracking systems such as CEIPAL, Bullhorn, JobDiva, and similar platforms.
* Assess recruiters' knowledge of candidate sourcing, submissions, interview coordination, and placement closures.

**4. Recruitment Team Development**

* Support the expansion of the US IT Staffing recruitment team.
* Hire US IT Recruiters, Senior Recruiters, Team Leads, Bench Sales Recruiters, and Recruitment Managers.
* Maintain a database of qualified recruitment professionals.
* Build relationships with potential candidates for current and future hiring requirements.
* Coordinate with management to understand hiring targets and workforce requirements.

**5. Recruitment Reporting & Performance**

* Maintain daily and weekly hiring reports.
* Track candidate sourcing, screening, interviews, offers, and joining status.
* Monitor recruitment turnaround time and offer acceptance rates.
* Ensure timely closure of hiring requirements.
* Provide regular hiring updates to management.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in Talent Acquisition or recruitment, preferably within the US IT Staffing industry.
* Proven experience hiring US IT Recruiters and staffing professionals.
* Good understanding of W2, C2C, 1099, and US IT recruitment processes.
* Strong sourcing experience using Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, and other recruitment platforms.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to handle multiple hiring requirements simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of recruitment KPIs and hiring performance metrics.
* Experience working in a fast-paced staffing environment.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Have previously worked as HR Recruiters or Talent Acquisition Specialists in US IT Staffing companies.
* Have successfully hired W2 Recruiters, C2C Recruiters, and Bench Sales Recruiters.
* Possess an active network of experienced US IT recruitment professionals.
* Understand US staffing recruitment challenges and hiring expectations.
* Can independently manage recruiter hiring from sourcing to onboarding.
* Are comfortable coordinating with recruitment managers and leadership.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Number of qualified recruiter profiles sourced.
* Number of interviews scheduled and completed.
* Number of offers released and accepted.
* Monthly recruiter hiring closures.
* Offer-to-joining conversion rate.
* Recruitment turnaround time.
* New-hire retention.

Interested candidates with relevant experience in Talent Acquisition and US IT Staffing recruitment are encouraged to apply.

title: IT, Facilities & Lab Operations Manager
description:
**IT, Facilities & Lab Operations Manager**
===========================================

**Location:** Bengaluru, India | On-site

**Company:** Ayar Labs

**Position Overview**
---------------------

Great engineering depends on a workplace that works: laptops ready on day one, reliable connectivity, an organized lab, and someone nearby who can figure out what’s wrong and get it fixed.

At Ayar Labs, we’re building optical I/O technology for high-performance computing. We’re looking for a resourceful, hands-on IT, Facilities & Lab Operations Manager to support our India office and help our engineers do their best work. You’ll be the local person people turn to for technical help and practical solutions, working closely with the office manager and our global IT and lab teams.

This is an on-site role with plenty of variety. One morning, you might help a colleague get connected, set up a new workstation, or troubleshoot hardware with a remote IT teammate. Later, you might organize a lab bench, check a portable clean dry air (CDA) system, or coordinate a repair with a service provider. You’ll manage day-to-day operations through direct, hands-on work, with room to improve how the site runs as it grows.

**What You’ll Achieve**
-----------------------

  

* **An engineering team that can stay focused.** Provide friendly, responsive helpdesk support for computers, software, accounts, connectivity, and meeting-room technology. Help new colleagues get started, keep users informed, and follow issues through to resolution. Work with global IT on access, device setup, updates, and security practices.
  
* **Reliable cloud support for the EDA team.** Support engineering teams in an AWS environment. Partner with global IT and EDA to help provision and maintain Linux compute environments, manage user access, and troubleshoot connectivity, storage, and tool-license access issues so engineers can keep design and simulation workloads running.
  
* **Local hands for a global team.** Be the on-site eyes and hands for remote IT and engineering colleagues. Help install and connect equipment, inspect hardware, trace and label cables, replace approved components, and carry out guided troubleshooting. Capture useful details so specialists can resolve issues quickly.
  
* **Labs and workspaces that are ready to use.** Keep benches, equipment, tools, spares, and supplies organized and easy to find. Maintain practical inventory and maintenance records, support equipment setup and moves, and coordinate service or calibration with lab owners and vendors. Follow lab safety and equipment-handling procedures, including electrostatic discharge (ESD) precautions where applicable.
  
* **Small facilities problems are handled before they become disruptions.** Partner with the office manager on everyday upkeep, minor repairs, and simple installations. Support routine checks and basic upkeep of portable CDA systems and other supporting equipment within your training and approved procedures. Coordinate with building management and qualified service providers when work needs specialist attention, and follow through until it’s complete.
  
* **Better ways of working.** Turn recurring problems into practical improvements. Keep clear support notes, useful checklists, and straightforward how-to guides. Help plan equipment and supply needs, flag risks early, and coordinate priorities with the office manager, IT, and engineering.

**Skills You’ll Need to Bring**
-------------------------------

  

* **5+ years of IT experience**, with hands-on helpdesk, desktop support, systems administration, or similar work supporting employees directly.
  
* A practical troubleshooting foundation across computer hardware, operating systems, business applications, user access, and basic networking. You can work through an unfamiliar problem and recognize when to bring in a specialist.
  
* Comfort with light facilities work: using basic tools, fixing small problems, helping set up workspaces, and learning the routine care of equipment such as portable CDA systems.
  
* Strong organization skills and a habit of leaving labs, workspaces, equipment records, and shared supplies easier for others to use.
  
* Clear communication, patience with users, and dependable follow-through. You can work independently on-site while coordinating effectively with remote colleagues and local vendors.
  

Experience in a semiconductor, electronics, or photonics lab is a plus. Familiarity with Linux, Windows, lab equipment handling, ESD practices, asset tracking, or small-office facilities support will also help. You don’t need to have done every part of this role already; we’re looking for a solid IT foundation, practical judgment, and an interest in learning the rest.

**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------

You’ll see the impact of your work every day: a new hire ready to contribute, a lab setup back in service, or an engineer able to keep working because you spotted and solved a problem. You’ll work close to the engineering team, build experience across IT and lab operations, and help shape a workplace people can rely on.

If you enjoy helping people, working with your hands, and making things run better, we’d like to hear from you.

**NOTE TO RECRUITERS:** Principals only. We are not accepting resumes from recruiters for this position. Remuneration for recruiting activities is only applicable subject to a signed and executed agreement between the parties. Please don’t send candidates to Ayar Labs, and do not contact our managers.

**About Ayar Labs**
-------------------

At Ayar Labs we’re about to revolutionize computing by moving data with light. We’re unleashing processing power for artificial intelligence, high performance computing, cloud and telecommunications by removing the bottlenecks created by today’s electrical I/O - making it possible to continue scaling computing system performance. Ayar Labs is the first to deliver an optical I/O solution that combines in-package optical I/O chiplets and multi-wavelength remote light sources to replace traditional electrical I/O. This silicon photonics-based I/O solution enables chips to communicate with each other from millimeters to kilometers, to deliver orders of magnitude improvements in latency, bandwidth density, and power consumption.

With our strong collaborations with industry leaders and government, our deep ties to MIT and UC Berkeley, and our commitment to hiring the best engineers in photonics and electronics, joining our team gives you the opportunity to collaborate with renowned experts on challenging, paradigm-shifting work.

We are passionate about delivering in-package optical I/O at scale, leveraging the strength of our patent portfolio and our team of leading interdisciplinary experts. We believe that deep cross-collaboration between teams facilitated by honest, open debate is the best way to drive innovation and achieve big wins. Join our team and experience the possibilities.

To manage day-to-day HR operations and employee lifecycle activities, including recruitment coordination, onboarding, attendance and leave administration, background verification, employee medical insurance, payroll coordination and statutory compliance, ensuring smooth HR service delivery and adherence to company policies

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Recruitment & Talent Acquisition:**

* Coordinate with hiring managers to understand manpower requirements and job specifications.
* Source candidates through job portals, consultants, employee referrals and other channels.
* Screen resumes, schedule interviews and coordinate with candidates and interview panels.
* Follow up on interview feedback, salary approvals and offer releases.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and provide regular updates on hiring status.

**Employee Onboarding & Documentation:**

* Manage joining formalities, document collection and verification.
* Coordinate pre-joining communication, induction and employee orientation.
* Offer Generation.
* Ensure timely creation of employee records in HRMS and maintenance of personnel files.
* Coordinate employee ID creation, system access and other joining requirements.
* Ensure completion of joining documentation and policy acknowledgements.

**Attendance & Leave Management:**

* Monitor daily attendance, absenteeism, late coming and missed punches.
* Track attendance regularization requests and obtain approvals from reporting managers.
* Manage leave applications, balances, encashment and related records as per company policy.
* Coordinate with managers and employees to resolve attendance and leave discrepancies.
* Verify monthly attendance and prepare accurate inputs for payroll processing.

**Background Verification (BGV):**

* Initiate background verification for new joiners through authorised agencies.
* Coordinate employment, education, address and identity verification, as applicable.
* Follow up on pending verification reports and maintain status trackers.
* Escalate discrepancies and adverse findings to the appropriate HR authority.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information and ensure secure recordkeeping.

**Mediclaim & Employee Benefits Management:**

* Coordinate employee group medical insurance enrolment, additions, deletions and policy renewals.
* Liaise with insurance providers, brokers and TPAs for employee queries and claims.
* Support employees with cashless hospitalisation, reimbursement documentation and claim follow-ups.
* Maintain employee and dependent insurance records and communicate benefit details.
* Support annual renewal activities and employee benefit reconciliation.

**Payroll Coordination:**

* Collect, validate and consolidate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, leave, new joiners, exits, incentives and approved deductions.
* Coordinate with the payroll team to ensure timely and accurate salary processing.
* Verify payroll reports and investigate discrepancies before finalisation.
* Support full and final settlement calculations and exit-related payroll inputs.
* Maintain payroll records and ensure confidentiality of salary information

**Statutory Compliance:**

* Working knowledge of applicable labour laws and statutory requirements, including EPF, ESI, professional tax, labour welfare fund and applicable minimum wage requirements.
* Coordinate collection and validation of statutory payroll inputs and employee records.
* Support preparation of statutory returns, challans, registers and compliance documentation.

**Employee Lifecycle & HR Operations:**

* Maintain employee master data, personnel files and HRMS records.
* Coordinate employee confirmation, transfers, promotions, changes in designation and separation formalities.
* Conduct exit formalities, collect feedback and coordinate clearance processes.
* Respond to employee queries related to HR policies, payroll, leave, insurance and documentation.
* Prepare HR MIS, dashboards, trackers and periodic reports for management.
* Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, documentation and service delivery.

**Employee Exit Formalities & Full and Final Settlement:**

* Coordinate employee resignation acceptance, notice period tracking and exit formalities.
* Initiate and monitor exit clearance from respective departments, including IT, Admin, Finance and other stakeholders.
* Conduct exit interviews and document employee feedback, wherever applicable.
* Coordinate full and final settlement inputs, including pending salary, leave encashment, notice pay, recoveries and other applicable dues.

**PF Withdrawal & Employee Provident Fund Support:**

* Assist former and current employees with queries related to EPF withdrawal, transfer and claim status.
* Guide employees on the applicable EPFO processes, online claim submission and required documentation.
* Support employees in resolving issues related to UAN activation, KYC updates, Aadhaar linking and bank detail validation, as applicable.
* Coordinate with the payroll team and relevant stakeholders to resolve PF contribution discrepancies and employee record issues.

**Employee Query Management & HR Helpdesk:**

* Act as the first point of contact for employee queries related to HR policies, payroll, attendance, leave, medi-claim, PF, onboarding and separation.
* Respond to employee queries through email, telephone, HRMS or other designated communication channels.
* Record, categorise and track employee queries in an HR query tracker or helpdesk system.
* Coordinate with relevant HR team members, payroll, Finance, Admin and external service providers to resolve queries within defined timelines.

**Educational Qualifications:**

* Graduate in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* MBA / PG Diploma in HR will be an added advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* Time taken to complete recruitment coordination and joining formalities.
* Onboarding documentation completion rate.
* Attendance and leave data accuracy.
* Timely closure of background verification cases.
* Accuracy and timeliness of payroll inputs.
* Timely employee insurance enrolment and query resolution.
* Statutory compliance adherence and timely submission of required inputs.
* Accuracy of employee master data and HR MIS.
* Employee query resolution turnaround time.

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.

We work at the intersection of strategy, supply chain, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.

**Role Overview:**

You will own hands-on configuration, testing, and continuous improvement of a global Manhattan Active WM template in a large, multi-customer program rolling out across dozens of warehouse sites a year. Working from approved functional designs, you turn requirements into standardized, reusable configuration and keep customer-specific complexity out of the template. The role works hours aligned to US business hours (an evening and night shift in IST), with occasional international travel for go-lives, planned with 6 to 8 weeks' notice (a valid US B1/B2 visa is a plus).

**Mandate:**

* Configure Manhattan Active WM independently from approved functional designs and template requirements

* Test, package, and deploy configuration changes through a controlled release process

description:

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you will be the first point of contact for our clients, ensuring their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You will proactively identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, focusing on first-line support for standard and low-complexity incidents and service requests. Your aim? To ensure zero missed service level agreement conditions.  
  
Every day, you will monitor client infrastructure and solutions, identifying problems and errors before or as they occur. You will dive deep into first-line incidents assigned to you, pinpointing the root causes, and providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support to our clients when they need it most. Maintenance activities, such as patching and configuration changes, will be part of your routine, ensuring the smooth operation of client systems.  
  
You will work across two or more technology domains, such as Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications, or Collaboration. Your day may include updating existing knowledge articles or creating new ones, seeking opportunities for work optimization, and supporting project work as needed. Additionally, you will contribute to disaster recovery functions and tests, ensuring our clients' DATA is safe and sound.  
  
Shift changes are made seamless with your careful handovers, ensuring service continuity. * Entry-level experience with troubleshooting and support in security, network, DATA centre, systems, or storage within a medium to large ICT organization.

* Understanding of Enterprise Data Warehouse like Bigdata, Teradata
* Exposure to SAS, Python, SQL/data retrieving tools

Good understanding of

* Data definitions and data discovery
* Data quality framework
* Data Governance including identification of critical data elements, measuring and monitoring of CDE’s
* Process improvement experience pertains to compliance and data quality initiatives
* Hands on experience on KPI’s design, issue resolution and remediation activities

* Measuring effectiveness of different DQ roll out programs

* Ability to identify, clearly articulate and solve complex business problems and present them to the management in a structured and simpler form
* Should have excellent communication and inter-personal skills
* Good process/project management skills

* MBA / Master degree in Economics / Statistics / Mathematics / Information Technology / Computer Applications / Engineering from a premier institute. BTech / B.E in Information Technology / Information Systems / Computer Applications

* Have experience with using AI to enhance and optimize accounting, finance, and business systems process is a plus
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and troubleshoot issues and support solutions from design to implementation
* A proactive attitude with a desire to learn new skills in a flexible, fast-paced environment

**About Sukoon Health**

Sukoon provides inpatient mental healthcare for severe and complex mental health conditions and addiction. We are looking for a commercial leader who can help patients access high-quality care by strengthening referral relationships, developing effective sales teams and turning market opportunities into measurable business growth.

You will lead national sales and business development across our markets. Your work will combine time in the field with city managers and representatives, rigorous account planning, revenue-generating events and sales collateral that helps people understand Sukoon’s value. You will work closely with clinical, marketing, admissions, customer care and operations teams.

**Role Overview**

This is a role for someone who takes ownership of results and improves how other people sell. You should be comfortable accompanying representatives, demonstrating a consultative sales conversation, coaching managers and making clear decisions about account priorities and investment. You will join an existing operation with targets, processes and training in place, and strengthen execution while addressing specific gaps.

Success means more productive referral accounts, better sales-team performance, qualified opportunities from events and partnerships, and reliable progress against revenue targets. You must be able to explain what you changed, how it worked and how the team can repeat it.

**Roles & Responsibities**

Sales leadership and account development

1. Own national commercial performance

* Translate national and city revenue targets into channel, territory and account plans.
* Diagnose performance gaps using account potential, referral activity, conversion, capacity and commercial economics.
* Identify the few actions most likely to close those gaps and hold clear owners accountable.
* Maintain a credible forecast and explain variances early.
* Allocate sales effort and approved budgets to opportunities with a clear rationale.
* Work with Finance and the Head of Growth on channel economics, investment decisions and corrective action.

2. Build productive referral relationships

* Segment and prioritise doctors, clinics, hospitals and other relevant partners based on clinical relevance, account potential and relationship stage.
* Understand their unmet needs, referral barriers and current alternatives.
* Develop account plans with a specific proposition, next action, owner and date.
* Activate appropriate new accounts, deepen productive relationships and re-engage lapsed referrers.
* Work with Sukoon clinicians to build professional trust through meaningful conversations and evidence.
* Ensure partners understand referral pathways and receive timely follow-through from the relevant teams.
* Explore partnerships where they support the agreed growth strategy.
* Assess fit, expected demand, delivery requirements, economics and ownership before proposing an investment.
* Referral development remains a core responsibility; expansion into other channels must have a clear business case.

3. Coach in the field

* Spend regular time with city managers and frontline representatives. Observe real meetings, diagnose the skills or account barriers involved and demonstrate effective discovery, value explanation, objection handling and next-step agreement. Give specific feedback and follow up on whether behaviour and results improve.
* Teach managers to coach their teams consistently. Use existing training materials and performance data to identify development needs. Translate training into practice through joint visits, role-play, account reviews and individual development plans. Measure improvements in representative productivity and target attainment.

4. Build a capable sales organisation

* Clarify responsibilities, territory coverage, manager spans and account ownership. Set hiring standards, interview and assess sales talent, improve onboarding and ramp-up, and address persistent underperformance. Make staffing proposals based on workload, geography and account opportunity.
* Create a culture of preparation, honest reporting and reliable follow-through. Recognise results and effective behaviours, and ensure reviews lead to useful decisions. Develop managers who can sustain performance without every issue escalating to the national leader.

Events collateral and commercial execution

1. Create events that develop business

* Design and execute targeted clinician roundtables, facility visits, educational discussions and other relevant engagement formats. Choose the audience and format around a specific account opportunity or referral barrier. Work with clinical colleagues on content and marketing colleagues on invitations and delivery.
* Own the commercial plan for each event: target accounts, proposition, attendee recruitment, approved budget, representative preparation, intended next actions and follow-up. Track full costs and evaluate qualified opportunities, productive accounts and attributable revenue over an agreed period.
* Assign follow-up owners before the event. Ensure opportunities are recorded and progressed in the CRM. Distinguish newly generated business from influence on existing opportunities. Use results to decide which formats to repeat, improve or discontinue.

2. Know what sales collateral to build

* Audit existing materials and identify gaps by audience, sales stage and recurring question or objection. Brief marketing on assets such as referral guides, clinical capability summaries, evidence-based case examples, care-journey explanations, FAQs, presentations and event follow-up material.

Test material in real conversations, teach teams to use it and improve it based on feedback and account progression.

3. Strengthen execution across teams

Support the clinical team’s patient conversations through relevant information and feedback while respecting assigned ownership.

4. Exercise sound healthcare judgment

* Represent Sukoon accurately and communicate value with evidence. Protect patient confidentiality and ensure patient stories and clinical claims have appropriate approval. Build trust with clinicians, partners and families through clear, respectful communication.
* Clinical decisions remain with clinicians. Commercial targets must support clinically appropriate care and informed patient choice. You are accountable for referral-channel performance and sales execution; clinical recommendations and lengths of stay are not sales decisions.

**How accountability will work**

* Revenue and admission outcomes depend on clinical eligibility, patient choice, facility capacity and patient-facing execution. You will own the sales actions and account relationships within your control, diagnose shared barriers and coordinate resolution. Reviews will distinguish weak sales execution from other causes of performance variance.
* Productive-account and conversion definitions will use consistent windows and denominators. Registered contacts and raw visit counts will not substitute for qualified opportunities or account outcomes. Count unique referrals consistently and avoid duplicate revenue credit across channels and events.
* The scorecard will inform priorities and performance assessment. Incentive terms and weightings will be specified separately in the employment offer.

City managers can explain their account priorities and coach their teams effectively. Representatives understand partner needs, communicate Sukoon’s value and secure meaningful next steps. **Job Description – Senior Cybersecurity Incident Response Specialist**

**Experience:** 8–10 Years  
  
**Function:** Cybersecurity – Incident Response / DFIR  
  
**Role Level:** Senior

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Incident Response Specialist with 8–10 years of hands-on cybersecurity experience to manage and investigate security incidents across enterprise environments.

The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end ownership of cybersecurity incidents, including triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), malware analysis, and digital forensic analysis. The role also requires strong customer-facing skills to lead incident discussions, provide regular updates, explain technical findings, and present investigation outcomes and recommendations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Incident Response & Investigation**

* Take end-to-end ownership of cybersecurity incidents from initial detection through closure.
* Lead investigation of Critical, High, and complex security incidents and coordinate response activities across relevant teams.
* Perform incident triage, scoping, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis.
* Investigate incidents involving ransomware, malware, phishing, account compromise, credential theft, data exfiltration, insider threats, web attacks, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and other advanced threats.
* Analyze security alerts and correlate information across EDR, SIEM, network, identity, cloud, email, and other security technologies.
* Develop incident timelines and determine the attack vector, affected assets, compromised accounts, attacker activity, persistence mechanisms, and overall impact.
* Identify Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), attacker Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), and map findings to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Coordinate with SOC, Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence, IT, Cloud, Network, IAM, Application, Legal, and other stakeholders during major incidents.

**Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**

* Perform detailed **Root Cause Analysis** for security incidents.
* Determine the initial attack vector, contributing factors, security/control gaps, and reasons existing preventive or detective controls did not stop or detect the activity earlier.
* Conduct post-incident reviews and lessons-learned sessions.
* Develop clear corrective and preventive actions based on investigation findings.
* Track remediation recommendations with relevant stakeholders through closure.
* Prepare comprehensive RCA reports suitable for technical teams, management, and customers.

**Malware Analysis**

* Perform static and dynamic malware analysis to understand malicious file behavior and capabilities.
* Analyze suspicious executables, scripts, PowerShell commands, documents, URLs, and other artifacts.
* Identify malware persistence mechanisms, command-and-control activity, network indicators, file-system changes, registry modifications, and related behaviors.
* Extract IOCs and behavioral indicators for threat hunting and detection engineering.
* Perform malware sandboxing and behavioral analysis where required.
* Provide recommendations for detection, containment, and prevention based on malware-analysis findings.

**Digital Forensics**

* Perform digital forensic investigations on endpoints and other relevant systems.
* Analyze Windows/Linux artifacts, event logs, file systems, registry artifacts, browser artifacts, authentication logs, memory artifacts, and other forensic evidence.
* Perform disk and memory analysis where required.
* Collect and preserve digital evidence following appropriate forensic procedures and chain-of-custody requirements.
* Build forensic timelines and reconstruct attacker activities.
* Determine the scope and impact of compromise using forensic evidence.
* Document forensic findings clearly and maintain investigation evidence appropriately.

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a key technical point of contact for customers during cybersecurity incidents.
* Lead incident calls and communicate investigation progress, impact, containment status, risks, and next steps.
* Provide timely and accurate incident updates to customers and internal leadership.
* Translate complex technical investigation findings into clear business-level communication.
* Manage customer expectations during high-severity and time-sensitive incidents.
* Present RCA and forensic investigation findings to customers and senior stakeholders.
* Handle technical questions and confidently explain investigation methodology, evidence, conclusions, and recommendations.
* Coordinate with multiple internal and customer teams to drive incidents toward timely resolution.

**Incident Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare detailed incident investigation reports, including:
* Maintain accurate incident records, evidence, investigation notes, and supporting documentation.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of Incident Response playbooks, SOPs, investigation procedures, and escalation processes.
* Executive summary
* Incident timeline
* Scope and impact
* Root cause
* Attack vector
* IOCs and TTPs
* Investigation findings
* Containment and remediation actions
* Control gaps
* Corrective and preventive recommendations
* Lessons learned

**Required Technical Skills**

The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in:

* Cybersecurity Incident Response / DFIR
* Security Incident Investigation
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Digital Forensics
* Malware Analysis
* Threat Hunting
* Endpoint and Network Investigation
* Windows and Linux Forensics
* Disk and Memory Analysis
* Log Analysis and Timeline Reconstruction
* IOC and TTP Analysis
* MITRE ATT&CK Framework
* SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, or similar
* EDR/XDR platforms such as CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, or similar
* Network security technologies including Firewall, IDS/IPS, Proxy, DNS, VPN, and WAF
* Cloud security investigation across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP environments
* Identity and authentication-related investigations
* Email and phishing investigations
* Forensic and malware-analysis tools such as Volatility, Autopsy, FTK, EnCase, Wireshark, Sysinternals, YARA, Ghidra, IDA, or equivalent tools
* Scripting/automation using Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies would be an advantage.

**Required Experience**

* 8–10 years of overall cybersecurity experience, with significant hands-on experience in Incident Response, DFIR, SOC, Threat Hunting, or related security domains.
* Demonstrated experience independently handling complex and high-severity cybersecurity incidents.
* Strong experience conducting RCA and presenting investigation findings.
* Hands-on experience with malware and forensic investigations.
* Experience handling customer-facing security incidents and leading technical/customer incident calls.
* Experience coordinating investigations involving multiple technical and business teams.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure during Critical/High-severity incidents.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

**Communication & Leadership Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer-facing and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to lead incident bridges/calls during critical incidents.
* Strong documentation and report-writing skills.
* Ability to take ownership, make investigation decisions, and drive incidents to closure.
* Ability to mentor junior Incident Response/SOC analysts and provide technical guidance during investigations.
